headline: Pensions: What the Fiscal Council Sees as Correct – The Big Question Mark
summary: Greece's Fiscal Council president said decisions announced for pension reform are moving in the right direction at first glance. The council's president also raised a big question mark over the plan.
why: Pension spending is a major component of Greece's budget, so reform design affects fiscal sustainability and sovereign debt assessments.
